name: v224_cfi_guidance_largecap_market
hypothesis: Stable cash-flow-from-investing guidance may proxy disciplined capital allocation, but prior versions were TOP1000 fragile; a stricter cap gate and MARKET neutralization test whether the signal survives in larger, more liquid names.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.60, 0.390 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63)), 126), industry) + 0.270 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.050 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Final large-cap LSUS repair for the CFI-guidance low-corr seed.

name: v224_cfi_guidance_subindustry
hypothesis: CFI guidance stability may be more comparable within narrower industries; SUBINDUSTRY ranking tests whether LSUS improves without adding old stabilizers.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.390 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63)), 126), subindustry) + 0.270 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), subindustry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.050 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Narrow peer repair; reject if Fitness drops or LSUS remains failed.

name: v224_cfi_guidance_signal_only
hypothesis: If CFI guidance is a genuine parent, the guidance stability and analyst-count components should retain signal without beta/reversal relief.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.450 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63)), 126), industry) + 0.320 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), industry), -1)
notes: Signal-only diagnostic; do not submit unless it unexpectedly clears all gates and corr.

name: v224_cfi_actual_guidance_alignment
hypothesis: Guided investing-cash-flow discipline is more credible when actual CFI is close to guidance and analyst coverage is improving, which may reduce the small-cap fragility of pure guidance range signals.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.330 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_cfi_value - (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / 2) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.080 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Adds CFI actual-vs-guidance alignment, still avoiding FCF/EV/competitor/book/PPE stabilizers.
